specs.title: Access lifecycle: suspension, revoked invitations and session ownership
AUDIT wrong finance methods and extra path segments cannot write
AUDIT payment replay is atomic and changed payload is rejected
AUDIT stock request replay creates a single movement
AUDIT invalid status is rejected by backend
AUDIT dashboard exposes only activity summary and validates date range
AUDIT finance selector includes documents beyond first page
AUDIT every generic record module persists CRUD and rejects cross-tenant updates
AUDIT purchase receipt and partial supplier payment reconcile dashboard
DE01 preference persistence, user/tenant isolation and concurrent conflict/reset version
DE02 strict hostile payload, bounds, unknown types, extra identities and schema writes
DE03 every widget reads real DB with server RBAC; role downgrade preserves safe preference
DE04 schema read migration preserves valid settings and safe unknown omission
DE05 browser edit, drag/resize, no fetch while moving, undo/redo, cancel and persistence
DE06 catalog/settings/hide, login persistence, reset confirmation and mobile layouts
DE07 two browser tabs keep conflicting draft, failed save and widget error remain visible
DE08 accessible movement, Escape, dirty navigation, breakpoint separation and duplicate deduplication
DE09 real task aggregation, source data separation and filters
DE10 fifteen widgets interaction timing, request budget and screenshots
DE11 company switch in UI remounts personal preferences and role downgrade hides finance
DE12 visible cards do not overlap across breakpoints, prototype widget types are rejected
Dashboard summary preserves totals, reports and monthly charts across date filters
FC01 full sale: posted invoice, full receipt, statement and trial balance reconcile
FC02 partial receipt 1200-500=700; historical aging ignores later allocation
FC03 advance 300 is liability, later allocated once; linked allocation reversal preserves history
FC04 purchase receipt and two partial invoices do not double-post inventory; supplier partial payment
FC05 payment across two invoices and concurrent over-allocation roll back atomically
FC06 partial credit note and payment reversal retain originals; posted journals immutable
FC07 tenant and role controls protect all finance resources and composite references
FC08 parallel invoice posting idempotency: one source journal; different content rejected
FC09 periods reject unbalanced and closed posting; reversing in another open period is supported
FC10 finance UI persists invoice, posts it and shows the same open balance on the statement
FC11 Turkish invoice PDF and CSV exports enforce authorization and tenant scope
FC12 knowledge cutoff, expired original tax credit, supplier advance and temporal double-use rejection
FC13 concurrent internal numbers and payment idempotency create one cash/journal effect
FC14 legacy cash stays explicit and unposted; compatibility and review references remain auditable
FC15 linked customer subaccount inherits control purpose and reconciles with the party statement
Tenant isolation on reads, writes and foreign record references
CRUD validates input and prevents stale updates, search/filter/pagination work
Purchase receipt → quote conversion → shipment → exact settlement
Concurrent stock exits cannot oversell; transfer rolls back atomically
Invitation is single use and viewer role is enforced on server
CSRF and unauthenticated requests are rejected, session cookie is HttpOnly
Browser login, real CRUD persistence, modal keyboard, dark/light and mobile layout
Payment reversal restores receivable, cannot reverse twice, original audit stays intact
Purchase request converts once into a persistent purchase order
Database constraints reject negative stock and immutable audit modification
Currency cannot relabel existing financial records and password change revokes other sessions
Lead conversion preserves notes and customer timeline links actual activity
Service lines fulfill without artificial stock movements
All module routes render without errors and reference motion respects reduced motion
Task changes update project progress transactionally and archive protects relationships
Partial receipts and shipments preserve remaining quantity, reject stale duplicates and roll back shortage
HARDENING one exhausted global bucket cannot block an unrelated login
HARDENING stock and finance require a replay key before writing
HARDENING rate counter is atomic across simultaneous expired-window requests
HARDENING document line rejects another tenant product in raw DB write
Animated navigation does not flash outgoing content and latest click wins
RC read RBAC: API, dashboard, history, deliveries and UI across seven roles
RC login budgets: atomic concurrency, spoof resistance, success and account recovery; password change and historical hash
Private shell metadata, crawl policy and unauthenticated API remain safe
Manifest and brand assets have real formats and dimensions
Reference shell geometry and stable visual baselines: dark/light/mobile
